compatibility_policy: Additive changes within v1; breaking changes require a new major schema file and migration note.

tools.name: create_document
tools.title: Create Word document
tools.description: Use this when a new DOCX is needed. Creates an isolated draft; it does not overwrite any user file. Page settings are bounded and the result must be saved/exported explicitly.

tools.name: create_from_template
tools.title: Create from Word template
tools.description: Use this when a DOCX or DOTX template must be preserved. Downloads only the authorized file reference, rejects macros and unsafe packages, copies it into an isolated session, and creates a new DOCX draft.

tools.name: create_from_markdown
tools.title: Create from Markdown
tools.description: Use this when Markdown must become a new DOCX. Accepts raw Markdown or an authorized .md file, preserves a supplied template only when separately requested, and never converts an existing DOCX through Markdown.

tools.name: open_document
tools.title: Open Word document
tools.description: Use this when an uploaded DOCX must be inspected or edited. Reads an authorized ChatGPT file reference, rejects DOCM/DOTM, ZIP bombs, XXE and unsafe relationships, then opens an isolated round-trip draft.

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.title: Inspect Word document
tools.description: Use this for a read-only overview of package parts, structure, styles, sections, tables and native equations. It does not save or mutate the draft.

tools.name: save_document
tools.title: Save Word document
tools.description: Use this to create a new validated DOCX version. It never overwrites the uploaded original. Saving may apply documented structural repairs and returns a temporary download link.

tools.name: close_document
tools.title: Close Word document
tools.description: Use this to discard the in-memory draft and delete its extracted temporary files. Previously exported versions remain available until their artifact expiry.

tools.name: get_outline
tools.title: Get document outline
tools.description: Use this to read heading levels, text and stable paragraph IDs without changing the draft.

tools.name: get_sections
tools.title: Get document sections
tools.description: Use this to inspect page sizes, margins, orientation, columns and section breaks without changing the draft.

tools.name: get_paragraph
tools.title: Get paragraph
tools.description: Use this to read one paragraph by its w14:paraId. It returns text and style but does not flatten the whole document.

tools.name: insert_paragraph
tools.title: Insert paragraph
tools.description: Use this to insert one styled paragraph after a known paragraph ID. It mutates only document.xml and preserves unrelated parts.

tools.name: replace_paragraph
tools.title: Replace paragraph
tools.description: Use this to replace the text and/or style of one paragraph. This is a direct edit, not a document rebuild; use insert_tracked_change when review markup is required.

tools.name: delete_paragraph
tools.title: Delete paragraph
tools.description: Use this to remove exactly one paragraph from the current draft. The uploaded original is untouched, but the draft mutation is destructive until rejected by reopening or restoring a prior export.

tools.name: move_block
tools.title: Move document block
tools.description: Use this to move one paragraph or top-level table before or after another block. References use p:<paraId> or table:<zero-based-index>.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.title: List Word styles
tools.description: Use this to inspect paragraph and character styles before applying formatting. It is read-only.

tools.name: create_style
tools.title: Create Word style
tools.description: Use this to add one named paragraph or character style to styles.xml. Prefer this over direct formatting for reusable formatting.

tools.name: update_style
tools.title: Update Word style
tools.description: Use this to change inheritance or next-style metadata of one existing named style. It does not replace unrelated style definitions.

tools.name: apply_style
tools.title: Apply Word style
tools.description: Use this to apply an existing style to explicit paragraph IDs. It avoids replacing template styles with direct formatting.

tools.name: inspect_direct_formatting
tools.title: Inspect direct formatting
tools.description: Use this to find run-level direct formatting that may override styles. It does not alter the document.

tools.name: normalize_formatting
tools.title: Normalize direct formatting
tools.description: Use this to remove supported direct run properties from selected paragraphs so style inheritance can take effect. It preserves fields, text and paragraph structure.

tools.name: format_paragraph
tools.title: Format one Word paragraph
tools.description: Set paragraph alignment, spacing, indentation, tab stops and pagination flags without changing its text or style assignment.

tools.name: format_run
tools.title: Format one Word run
tools.description: Set direct font, size, color, highlight, emphasis, underline, strike or sub/superscript on one run identified by paragraph and run index.

tools.name: manage_lists
tools.title: Manage Word lists
tools.description: Inspect, apply, create, restart, promote, demote or suppress native single- and multilevel Word numbering definitions.

tools.name: insert_caption
tools.title: Insert Word caption
tools.description: Insert a native Caption-styled paragraph with sequence text after a figure or table anchor.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.title: List Word tables
tools.description: Use this for a compact read-only inventory of tables and cell content.

tools.name: get_table
tools.title: Get Word table
tools.description: Use this to read one table by zero-based index, including its cells and properties.

tools.name: insert_table
tools.title: Insert Word table
tools.description: Use this to insert one native Word table after a paragraph. Row and column counts are bounded to prevent pathological documents.

tools.name: modify_table
tools.title: Modify Word table
tools.description: Use this for one bounded table operation: add_row, delete_row, delete_table, sort, apply_style or duplicate_row. It does not rebuild the document.

tools.name: merge_cells
tools.title: Merge table cells
tools.description: Use this to merge a rectangular range of cells in one table. Coordinates are zero-based and the operation changes table grid semantics.

tools.name: split_cells
tools.title: Split merged table cell
tools.description: Use this to remove supported horizontal/vertical merge properties from one cell. Complex irregular merges are reported rather than silently rebuilt.

tools.name: set_cell_properties
tools.title: Set table cell properties
tools.description: Use this to change one cell's width, vertical alignment or shading, optionally its row height. Only provided properties are touched.

tools.name: insert_equation
tools.title: Insert native Word equation
tools.description: Use this to insert LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, OMML or structured AST as native Office Math. Inline output is m:oMath; display output is m:oMathPara. No rasterization or text fallback occurs.

tools.name: replace_equation
tools.title: Replace native Word equation
tools.description: Use this to replace exactly one equation by equation_id while retaining native OMML and the surrounding document structure.

tools.name: list_equations
tools.title: List native Word equations
tools.description: Use this for a read-only inventory of m:oMath elements with stable per-draft IDs, display/inline status and canonical AST.

tools.name: get_equation
tools.title: Get native Word equation
tools.description: Use this to read one equation as OMML plus best-effort LaTeX, UnicodeMath, MathML and canonical AST.

tools.name: convert_equation
tools.title: Convert equation format
tools.description: Use this for a stateless semantic conversion among LaTeX, UnicodeMath, Presentation MathML, OMML and the WordToolkit AST. Unsupported syntax fails explicitly; no image or plain-text fallback is emitted.

tools.name: validate_equations
tools.title: Validate native Word equations
tools.description: Use this to parse every m:oMath in the current draft and report structural failures without modifying the document.

tools.name: number_equations
tools.title: Number display equations
tools.description: Use this to add automatic SEQ Equation fields and bookmarks after display equations. Existing source equations remain native OMML; fields are update-on-open in Word.

tools.name: add_equation_reference
tools.title: Add equation reference
tools.description: Use this to append a native REF field pointing to a numbered equation bookmark. Word updates the cached field value when fields are refreshed.

tools.name: manage_headers_footers
tools.title: Manage headers and footers
tools.description: Read, create, replace or remove a default/first/even header or footer story. PAGE and NUMPAGES placeholders use {{PAGE}} and {{NUMPAGES}} native fields.

tools.name: manage_footnotes_endnotes
tools.title: Manage footnotes and endnotes
tools.description: List, add, update, delete or structurally validate native Word footnotes/endnotes. Note references and definition parts are kept linked.

tools.name: manage_comments
tools.title: Manage Word comments
tools.description: List comment threads or add, reply, update, resolve and delete native Word comments and comment-extension metadata.

tools.name: manage_bookmarks
tools.title: Manage bookmarks
tools.description: List, add, read or remove Word bookmarks. Bookmark names are constrained to Word-compatible identifiers.

tools.name: manage_cross_references
tools.title: Manage cross references
tools.description: List hyperlinks or add an internal cross-reference between two paragraph IDs using a bookmark-backed Word hyperlink.

tools.name: manage_fields
tools.title: Manage Word fields
tools.description: List, add, delete or mark fields for update. Field codes are bounded; common values include TOC, PAGE, NUMPAGES and REF bookmark.

tools.name: insert_image
tools.title: Insert embedded image
tools.description: Download an authorized PNG/JPEG/GIF/TIFF image, verify its image type, then embed it through DrawingML. No external image relationship is created.

tools.name: manage_sections
tools.title: Manage Word sections
tools.description: Inspect or change page/section properties including breaks, size, margins, orientation, columns and first/odd-even headers.

tools.name: enable_track_changes
tools.title: Enable tracked changes
tools.description: Enable or disable Word's w:trackRevisions setting. This does not retroactively wrap existing content.

tools.name: list_tracked_changes
tools.title: List tracked changes
tools.description: Read pending w:ins and w:del revisions with author, date, paragraph and text; no mutation occurs.

tools.name: insert_tracked_change
tools.title: Insert tracked change
tools.description: Insert, delete or replace text using native Word revision elements. Context may be supplied to disambiguate a match.

tools.name: accept_changes
tools.title: Accept tracked changes
tools.description: Accept one change by ID or all pending revisions. This is destructive within the draft; the uploaded original remains untouched.

tools.name: reject_changes
tools.title: Reject tracked changes
tools.description: Reject one change by ID or all pending revisions. This is destructive within the draft; the uploaded original remains untouched.

tools.name: compare_documents
tools.title: Compare two Word documents
tools.description: Compare two authorized DOCX files and return a third DOCX containing native insertion/deletion revision markup. The inputs are never overwritten.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_package
tools.title: Inspect a Word OOXML package
tools.description: Read a local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM without opening Word. Return a bounded OPC graph summary, content-type and relationship diagnostics, a stable package fingerprint, and optional part metadata. Encrypted and partial encryption envelopes fail with distinct stable codes instead of generic ZIP corruption. External relationship targets are never fetched and remain redacted.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local Word package.

include_details.description: Include bounded part and relationship metadata; raw content is never returned.

max_items.description: Maximum diagnostics, parts, and relationships returned per collection.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_encryption
tools.title: Inspect OOXML encryption container
tools.description: Detect a standard, agile, extensible, malformed, or absent ECMA-376 encrypted-package envelope in a local OOXML file without opening Word. The bounded native parser accepts no password, decrypts no content, reads at most eight EncryptionInfo bytes, returns no paths or stream names, and never uses the network.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a local Word, Excel, PowerPoint or Office-theme OOXML file.

tools.name: transform_ooxml_package
tools.title: Transform a Word OOXML package
tools.description: Create a new DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM by applying one bounded, lossless high-level transform without opening Word: replace the first paragraph-local text occurrence, accept all tracked changes, or reject all tracked changes. The operation never overwrites a file, blocks signed packages, preserves untouched parts and unknown XML, validates the exact candidate before an atomic write, and fails closed when review semantics are unsupported.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the existing input Word package.

output_path.description: New output path with the same Word package extension. Existing files are never overwritten.

find_text.description: Required only for replace_first_text_occurrence; matching is ordinal and paragraph-local.

replace_text.description: Required only for replace_first_text_occurrence and may be empty.

tools.name: convert_ooxml_flat_opc
tools.title: Convert a Word package to or from Flat OPC
tools.description: Create a new bounded Flat OPC XML transport from DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM, or reconstruct a new matching Word package without opening Word. The native Engine streams package XML under DTD, depth, part-count, decoded-byte and Base64 limits, rebuilds content types, preserves binary and AltChunk payloads, blocks signed packages, verifies the Word semantic graph and exact relationship graph, and publishes only after semantic round-trip proof. Existing files are never overwritten and raw XML is never returned to the AI.

local_path.description: Existing DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM for to_flat_opc; existing .xml Flat OPC file for from_flat_opc.

output_path.description: New .xml path for to_flat_opc or a new Word package path whose extension matches the Flat OPC main-part content type.

tools.name: inspect_wordtoolkit_extensions
tools.title: Inspect registered WordToolkit extensions
tools.description: Return a bounded, content-free catalog of explicitly registered engine extensions and their versioned capability contracts. This operation does not scan or load assemblies, read a document, open Word, expose implementation types or paths, or use the network. Trusted in-process registration is not a sandbox. A non-none sandbox_profile is a host-enforced closed policy; the Windows AppContainer profile denies network, brokers explicit provider read roots and confines writes to the container's private profile. signed_manifest_session_pinned means the host verified a publisher-key-bound manifest for the complete provider runtime/model set and pins non-write-sharing resource handles for the session; it is not a generic provider installer or revocation service.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter over extension, capability, publisher, kind, and interface identifiers.

tools.name: inspect_libreoffice_backend
tools.title: Inspect an explicit LibreOffice backend executable
tools.description: Hash and execute one explicit local LibreOffice binary with only --version to verify a bounded reported product/version identity. The action never searches PATH, supplies a document argument, opens Microsoft Word, creates a profile, reads document content, or claims UNO, Writer, PDF, macro/update isolation, rendering, vendor authenticity, atomically bound executed bytes, or Word fidelity. It closes stdin, bounds stdout/stderr and timeout, attempts process-tree termination on timeout, and rehashes the executable after exit; the version process is not a sandbox and network isolation is not enforced.

executable_path.description: Exact absolute local LibreOffice executable path. PATH lookup, UNC, mapped-network, device-namespace and reparse-point paths are rejected.

expected_executable_sha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256 of the exact executable. A mismatch prevents process start.

tools.name: inspect_wordtoolkit_observability
tools.title: Inspect WordToolkit observability
tools.description: Return bounded runtime telemetry and content-free audit health or a small page of safe operation events. This action never reads a document, opens Word, returns arguments, paths, text, XML, relationship targets or binaries, and never uses the network. Correlation IDs and record hashes are separate opt-ins.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_semantics
tools.title: Inspect Word semantic structure
tools.description: Project a saved Word OOXML package into bounded, source-linked semantic nodes without opening Word. Traverses the main document plus related headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, comments and glossary stories, and returns stable node IDs, part counts, structure counts, and a compact outline.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

text_preview_chars.description: Maximum text characters returned per outline node; use zero to omit previews.

include_source_paths.description: Include source part URIs and XML paths for debugging or precise follow-up.

tools.name: query_ooxml_semantics
tools.title: Query Word semantic nodes
tools.description: Query all projected Word stories by semantic node kind, bounded text predicate, exact properties, source part, subtree, or structural ancestor/descendant predicates. Use a process-memory semantic index for repeated queries with indexed candidate selection; otherwise query one saved package directly. Returns stable node IDs and compact previews without opening Word or returning raw XML.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to one local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM. Use this or semantic_index_id, never both.

semantic_index_id.description: Unexpired process-memory handle returned by manage_ooxml_semantic_index.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Required with semantic_index_id and optional with local_path. When supplied, rejects a stale package before returning content.

kinds.description: Optional semantic node kinds. Omit to search every kind.

text.description: Optional text predicate. Matching streams across run/text boundaries when text_scope is subtree.

text_scope.description: Use subtree to match a paragraph, table, equation, or other container across its descendant text nodes.

property_equals.description: Optional exact semantic property predicates, for example {"style_id":"Definition"}.

kinds.description: Match when any strict ancestor has one of these semantic kinds.

property_equals.description: Every exact property must occur on the same matching ancestor.

ancestor.description: Require at least one strict ancestor satisfying all supplied predicates. Use this to find equations inside tables, comments, revisions, headers, or other containers.

kinds.description: Match when any strict descendant has one of these semantic kinds.

property_equals.description: Every exact property must occur on the same matching descendant.

descendant.description: Require at least one strict descendant satisfying all supplied predicates. Use {"kinds":["paragraph"],"descendant":{"kinds":["equation"]}} to select only paragraphs containing equations.

within_node_id.description: Optional semantic node whose subtree bounds the query.

source_part_uri.description: Optional exact OPC part URI filter.

include_properties.description: Include bounded semantic properties. Sensitive values remain redacted unless include_sensitive_properties is also true.

include_sensitive_properties.description: Return bounded author, initials, date, bookmark/glossary names, field instructions, hyperlink anchors and GUID values. Requires include_properties=true.

include_source.description: Include source part, normalized XML path, and lexical element ordinal.

tools.name: render_ooxml_semantic_html
tools.title: Render a semantic HTML preview of a Word package
tools.description: Create a deterministic, self-contained semantic HTML artifact from one saved DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM without opening Word. Render the configured story scope or one fingerprint-bound semantic node such as a table, row, cell, paragraph, equation or drawing. The vendor-neutral renderer preserves story, paragraph, table, revision, field-result and equation-text meaning, keeps hyperlinks inert, never loads external resources or executes active content, and writes only a new .html file. This is explicitly a non-paginated structural preview: it does not claim Microsoft Word layout, typography, drawing, pagination, or print fidelity.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to one local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM.

output_path.description: New local .html path. Existing files are never overwritten and the parent directory must already exist.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Optional exact package fingerprint. Supply it when rendering a previously inspected package to reject stale input.

story_scope.description: Render only the main document body, or also related headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, comments, and glossary stories.

language.description: Compact BCP 47-style language tag used on the HTML root.

target_node_id.description: Optional exact semantic node ID from the same inspected package. Requires expected_package_fingerprint. Only this subtree is rendered; table rows and cells receive a synthetic valid HTML table context.

artifact_contains_document_content.description: The created local HTML artifact contains document content even though the MCP response does not return that content.

selection_applied.description: True only when target_node_id restricted rendering to one semantic subtree.

tools.name: render_ooxml_semantic_svg
tools.title: Render one semantic Word object as safe SVG
tools.description: Create a deterministic, self-contained SVG artifact for one exact fingerprint-bound semantic node in a saved DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM without opening Word. The built-in vendor-neutral backend renders real selectable text plus estimated flow or table geometry, keeps hyperlinks inert, suppresses field instructions, and never loads external resources or executes active content. It is a non-paginated semantic vector preview: exact target identity is enforced, but Microsoft Word typography, object bounds, pagination, and pixel equivalence are explicitly not claimed.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to one local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM.

output_path.description: New local .svg path. Existing files are never overwritten and the parent directory must already exist.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Required exact package fingerprint that binds target_node_id to the inspected package version.

target_node_id.description: Required exact semantic node ID from the fingerprint-bound package. Standalone drawings, marker nodes and unsupported extension roots fail closed.

story_scope.description: Authorize a target in the main document body only, or in any projected text story. It never expands the selected subtree.

language.description: Compact BCP 47-style language tag used as xml:lang on the SVG root.

viewport_width_px.description: Deterministic SVG canvas width. Text wrapping uses estimated metrics and is not Word layout.

artifact_contains_document_content.description: The created local SVG artifact contains document content even though the MCP response does not return that content.

tools.name: render_ooxml_fixed_artifacts
tools.title: Render a saved Word package to authoritative PDF and page PNG artifacts
tools.description: Render an exact fingerprint-bound saved DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM through Microsoft Word's native fixed-format exporter. Word opens the package hidden and read-only with macros forced off, link updates disabled and no recent-file entry; the source hash is rechecked after close. The operation can publish a PDF, PNG pages derived from that exact PDF through an explicitly configured Poppler executable, or both, plus a provenance manifest. Every artifact is staged, validated and published as one no-clobber transaction. There is no silent Word, LibreOffice, browser or PATH fallback.

local_path.description: Local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM path. UNC and device paths are rejected.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Required exact fingerprint from a prior saved-package inspection.

output_directory.description: Existing local directory. Outputs are create-new and never overwrite files.

artifact_stem.description: Safe base name used for the PDF, page PNGs and .render.json manifest.

output.description: Publish Word PDF, PNG pages derived from the staging PDF, or both. A manifest is always published.

last_page.description: Inclusive source page. Null exports through the last Word page.

dpi.description: PNG raster DPI; ignored for PDF-only output.

include_markup.description: Export tracked markup instead of clean document content.

pdfinfo_path.description: Explicit local pdfinfo executable path for PNG output. If omitted, WORDTOOLKIT_PDFINFO_PATH must be configured; PATH is never searched.

rasterizer_path.description: Explicit local pdftoppm or pdftocairo executable path for PNG output. If omitted, WORDTOOLKIT_PDF_RASTERIZER_PATH must be configured; PATH is never searched.

tools.name: render_ooxml_libreoffice_artifacts
tools.title: Render a saved Word package through isolated LibreOffice Writer
tools.description: Render an exact fingerprint-bound saved DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM through a SHA-256-bound LibreOffice Writer and Java UNO process pair with a private profile and embedded reviewed WordToolkit helper. The operation requests hidden read-only loading, NEVER_EXECUTE macros and NO_UPDATE external updates, but reports that macro/update prevention is not behaviorally proved. It can publish LibreOffice PDF, PNG pages derived from that exact PDF through explicitly configured Poppler tools, or both, plus a provenance manifest. Private staging is deleted before one no-clobber public artifact transaction. It never opens Microsoft Word, never silently falls back, and never claims Microsoft Word layout fidelity.

local_path.description: Exact local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM path. UNC, device, symbolic-link and reparse paths are rejected.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Required fingerprint from a prior saved-package inspection.

output_directory.description: Existing local non-link directory. Outputs are create-new and never overwrite files.

libreoffice_executable_path.description: Exact absolute local LibreOffice entry-point path; PATH search is forbidden.

java_executable_path.description: Exact absolute local Java executable path; PATH search is forbidden.

libreoffice_jar_path.description: Exact resolved regular-file path to the LibreOffice Java archive.

last_page.description: Inclusive page. A non-default first_page requires a non-null last_page.

dpi.description: PNG raster DPI; ignored for PDF-only output.

pdfinfo_path.description: Explicit local pdfinfo path for PNG output. If omitted, WORDTOOLKIT_PDFINFO_PATH is required; PATH is not searched.

rasterizer_path.description: Explicit local pdftoppm or pdftocairo path for PNG output. If omitted, WORDTOOLKIT_PDF_RASTERIZER_PATH is required; PATH is not searched.

tools.name: manage_ooxml_semantic_index
tools.title: Manage a bounded in-memory Word semantic index
tools.description: Create, inspect, list, or explicitly release a short-lived semantic index for repeated AI queries over one saved Word package. The index stores the immutable semantic projection only in this native process, is fingerprint-bound, expires after at most 30 minutes, never returns raw document text, never persists index data, and never opens Word.

operation.description: Create or reuse an unchanged package index, inspect one handle, list compact active handles, or release one immediately.

local_path.description: Saved DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM path. Required only for create.

semantic_index_id.description: Process-memory handle required for inspect and release.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Optional on create and inspect/release; rejects a stale or mistaken package identity.

ttl_seconds.description: Create-only lifetime. Recreating an unchanged path and fingerprint reuses the handle and refreshes expiry.

tools.name: compare_ooxml_semantics
tools.title: Compare saved Word documents semantically
tools.description: Compare two saved Word OOXML packages without opening Word. Produces separate bounded OPC-entry and source-linked semantic differences across the main body, headers, footers, notes, comments, glossary entries, text boxes, tables, fields and equations. Matching prefers exact or durable identities, detects proven moves, labels contextual similarity, exposes ambiguity and alignment fallbacks, and never treats an opaque package change as semantic equality proof.

before_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the original DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

after_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the revised DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

expected_before_fingerprint.description: Optional exact package fingerprint precondition for the original file.

expected_after_fingerprint.description: Optional exact package fingerprint precondition for the revised file.

view.description: Start with summary. Load one bounded page of semantic changes, OPC entries, or matcher diagnostics only when needed.

scope_families.description: Optional Word-story family filter for view=changes.

minimum_similarity.description: Minimum explicitly reported contextual-match score. Exact and durable matching remains independent of this threshold.

include_sensitive.description: Allow bounded text previews and property values in view=changes.

text_preview_chars.description: Per-side preview bound; a positive value requires include_sensitive=true.

include_source.description: Include part URI, normalized source path and lexical element ordinal.

include_hashes.description: Include entry/subtree hashes and text comparison fingerprints.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_patch
tools.title: Plan an exact reversible Word package patch
tools.description: Compare two saved Word OOXML packages without opening Word and build a deterministic, reversible entry-payload patch plan. Returns a compact semantic and risk summary by default; operation and risk pages are opt-in and bounded.

before_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the original DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

after_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the target DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

include_hashes.description: Include per-entry payload hashes in view=operations.

tools.name: create_ooxml_patch
tools.title: Create a reviewed Word package patch artifact
tools.description: Rebuild an exact reviewed patch plan and persist a new deterministic .wtpatch artifact containing verified before and after entry payloads. Requires both package fingerprints and the reviewed patch ID; never overwrites an existing artifact.

patch_path.description: New absolute or workspace-relative .wtpatch output path. Existing files are rejected.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_patch
tools.title: Inspect a Word package patch artifact
tools.description: Validate a local .wtpatch archive, every payload hash, canonical operation ID, patch ID, archive path and resource bound without opening Word. Returns only compact metadata and an optional bounded operation page; payload bytes and raw XML are never returned.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_patch_apply
tools.title: Plan safe application of a Word package patch
tools.description: Rebuild a patch candidate against an exact saved-package fingerprint, recompute semantic differences and risk evidence, verify result package type against the destination extension, and compare baseline and candidate Open XML SDK validation results. Returns a deterministic destination-bound apply-plan ID and separate required authorization flags without writing the document or opening Word.

local_path.description: Existing DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM destination.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_patch
tools.title: Atomically apply a reviewed Word package patch
tools.description: Rebuild and atomically apply an exact reviewed .wtpatch artifact to a saved Word package. Requires the base fingerprint, patch ID and destination-bound apply-plan ID; enforces result package type against the in-place extension, validates the candidate, writes through a sibling temporary file, rechecks fingerprints, and keeps a recovery backup by default. Risk authorizations are separate and default to false.

allow_digital_signature_invalidation.description: Explicitly accept that changing a signed package may invalidate its signatures.

allow_active_content_changes.description: Explicitly authorize VBA, macro, OLE, embedded-package, ActiveX, or control changes.

allow_external_relationship_changes.description: Explicitly authorize added or removed external relationship targets.

allow_opaque_binary_changes.description: Explicitly authorize unclassified binary payload changes.

allow_new_structural_errors.description: Explicitly authorize newly introduced OPC or Open XML schema errors. Validation failure, truncation, or inability to open the candidate remains non-overridable.

keep_backup.description: Retain the atomic writer's sibling recovery backup after success.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_patch_rollback
tools.title: Plan safe rollback of an applied Word package patch
tools.description: Read an original .wtpatch artifact, derive its exact reverse patch, require the current saved package to match the original result fingerprint, recompute semantic, risk, package-type, and Open XML validation evidence, and return a deterministic destination-bound rollback-plan ID. The operation writes nothing and never opens Word.

local_path.description: Existing DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM currently in the original patch result state.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Exact current package fingerprint; for an unchanged applied patch this is the original result fingerprint.

expected_patch_id.description: Patch ID of the original forward artifact, not a caller-crafted reverse patch.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_patch_rollback
tools.title: Atomically roll back an applied Word package patch
tools.description: Rebuild the exact reverse of an original .wtpatch artifact and atomically restore the saved Word package after verifying its current fingerprint, source patch ID, destination-bound rollback-plan ID, risk authorizations, result type, and Open XML validation. Keeps a redo-capable recovery backup by default, returns no payloads or XML, and never opens Word.

keep_backup.description: Retain the atomic writer's sibling backup containing the pre-rollback state, so it can serve as explicit redo evidence.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_merge
tools.title: Plan a guarded three-way Word package merge
tools.description: Merge two saved Word branches against an explicit common ancestor without opening Word. Automatically selects one-sided and identical entry changes and composes disjoint lossless source-linked text edits; every other divergence becomes a stable conflict requiring an explicit resolution. Returns a compact summary by default and bounded conflict, entry, operation, risk, or schema-error pages on demand. The destination-bound apply-plan ID covers all three package fingerprints, resolutions, validation evidence, result type, and output path.

ancestor_path.description: Path to the common ancestor DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM package.

left_path.description: Path to the left branch package.

right_path.description: Path to the right branch package.

output_path.description: New DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM output path. The parent directory must exist and the file must not exist.

resolutions.description: Explicit resolutions for stable conflict IDs returned by an earlier plan. Omit unresolved conflicts to inspect them without producing a candidate.

include_hashes.description: Include per-side content hashes in conflict or operation pages.

include_text_previews.description: Include bounded text previews for semantic text conflicts. Off by default for privacy and token economy.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_merge
tools.title: Create a reviewed three-way Word merge result
tools.description: Recompute and create a reviewed three-way merge as a new Word package. Requires exact ancestor, left, and right fingerprints plus the destination-bound merge apply-plan ID. It never overwrites a file, rejects unresolved conflicts, validates the candidate with the Open XML SDK, enforces result type against the output extension, and keeps active-content, signature, external-link, opaque-binary, and new-error authorizations separate and false by default.

allow_digital_signature_invalidation.description: Explicitly accept that changing a signed package may invalidate its signatures.

allow_active_content_changes.description: Explicitly authorize selected VBA, macro, OLE, embedded-package, ActiveX, or control changes.

allow_external_relationship_changes.description: Explicitly authorize selected external relationship changes.

allow_opaque_binary_changes.description: Explicitly authorize selected unclassified binary payload changes.

allow_new_structural_errors.description: Explicitly authorize newly introduced OPC or Open XML schema errors. Validation failure, truncation, or inability to open the candidate remains non-overridable.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_sections
tools.title: Inspect Word sections and story bindings
tools.description: Resolve Word section boundaries, page properties, and effective default, first-page, and even-page header/footer bindings. Reports explicit, inherited, blank, and suppressed variants without opening Word or returning document text.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

binding_detail.description: Use effective for displayed targets, full for source relationship provenance, or none for section metadata only.

include_properties.description: Include bounded page size, margins, columns, numbering, orientation, and section-break properties.

include_story_part_uris.description: Include bounded referenced and unbound header/footer part URI inventories.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_styles
tools.title: Inspect Word styles and inheritance
tools.description: Inspect the typed styles.xml graph, document defaults, latent styles, and bounded basedOn inheritance diagnostics without opening Word. Metadata is returned by default; declared formatting and source provenance are opt-in to minimize AI tokens.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

detail.description: Use declared for normalized property blocks or inheritance for those blocks plus base-first style chains and source element ordinals.

include_latent_styles.description: Include latent-style defaults and at most 40 named exceptions.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded inheritance, linked-style, next-style, and default-style diagnostics.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_template_style_alignment
tools.title: Inspect deterministic template style alignment
tools.description: Compare a target Word package with a distinct DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM template package by stable style ID. Returns fingerprint-bound candidates for complete basedOn, next, linked-style, theme, numbering, and stylesWithEffects dependency closures. It never matches localized style names, attaches or mutates the template, returns document text or raw XML, or opens Word.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_template_style_alignment
tools.title: Plan deterministic template style alignment
tools.description: Build and independently validate an exact target-package candidate for a reviewed set of fingerprint-bound style-ID closures. The plan proves semantic-content preservation, exact inverse, target-only style preservation, mirrored stylesWithEffects, equivalent theme and numbering dependencies, and no new style, numbering, OPC, or Microsoft Open XML SDK errors. It does not mutate either package or open Word.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_template_style_alignment
tools.title: Apply reviewed template style alignment atomically
tools.description: Reproduce an exact reviewed plan, revalidate both package fingerprints and the template immediately before publication, reject signed targets and schema regressions, and atomically publish only the target styles parts with an optional sibling recovery backup. The template is never attached or mutated and Word is never opened.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_numbering
tools.title: Inspect, resolve, and execute Word numbering
tools.description: Inspect the typed numbering.xml graph, resolve one effective level, or execute Word-compatible paragraph list sequences without opening Word. Sequence execution keeps counter certainty separate from label certainty, models Word's higher-level restart cascade, qualified replacement-level start precedence, ignored replacement-level restart declarations, legal numbering, and the restart-after-section-break extension, and fails visibly on ambiguous revision/MCE views or unsupported locale-dependent formats. Document paragraph text is never returned.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Inventory numbering instances or abstract definitions, resolve one concrete level, or execute source-ordered paragraph list sequences.

number_id.description: Optional exact instance filter; required and positive for resolved_level and optional for sequences.

level_index.description: Required for resolved_level; optional exact level filter for sequences.

story_kind.description: Optional exact story filter valid only for sequences. Sequence counters are isolated per story root.

paragraph_node_id.description: Optional exact source-linked paragraph filter valid only for sequences.

detail.description: Use levels for level/override metadata or declared to add normalized paragraph/run properties and unmodeled element names.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded missing-reference, linkage, range, and corruption diagnostics.

include_source.description: Include source XML element ordinals.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_numbering_repair
tools.title: Plan a guarded Word numbering sequence restart
tools.description: Plan a source-linked restart of the remaining tail of one numbering instance in one Word story. The planner clones the exact w:num instance, binds every affected paragraph by semantic source identity, materializes direct numPr only where needed, writes a standard startOverride and synchronizes replacement-level start for the qualified Word compatibility profile, then reparses the candidate and proves unchanged text, unchanged earlier/unrelated sequences, exact target counter restart, no new numbering errors and a deterministic result fingerprint. It returns no paragraph text or raw XML and never opens Word.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_numbering_repair
tools.title: Apply a reviewed Word numbering sequence restart
tools.description: Rebuild and atomically apply the exact reviewed numbering restart to the fingerprinted source package. The action rejects changed intent, plan drift, concurrent changes, signatures, missing Microsoft Open XML validation and new schema errors; it retains a sibling recovery backup by default. It returns no paragraph text or raw XML and never opens Word.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_numbering_rebuild_candidates
tools.title: Inspect guarded numbering-rebuild candidates
tools.description: Bind up to 100 exact paragraph nodes to package-versioned numbering reconstruction candidates. The action reports current direct numbering, story/source identity and fixed block reasons for revisions, Markup Compatibility ambiguity or unsafe paragraph properties. It returns no paragraph text or raw XML and never opens Word.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_numbering_rebuild
tools.title: Plan semantic Word numbering reconstruction
tools.description: Plan one atomic batch that creates independent typed abstract numbering definitions and instances, creates missing numbering OPC infrastructure when necessary, and assigns exact paragraphs to declared levels. The engine allocates every OOXML identifier, reparses the candidate, proves preserved text/topology/unselected sequences, exact supported counters and labels, no new numbering errors and an exact inverse. It accepts no XML, returns no paragraph text or XML, writes nothing and never opens Word.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_numbering_rebuild
tools.title: Apply reviewed Word numbering reconstruction
tools.description: Rebuild and atomically publish the exact reviewed semantic numbering plan to the fingerprinted package. Apply reproduces the typed command batch, rejects plan drift, concurrent changes, signatures, missing Microsoft Open XML validation and new schema errors, and retains a sibling recovery backup by default. It accepts no XML, returns no paragraph text or XML, and never opens Word.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_heading_outline
tools.title: Inspect the typed Word heading outline
tools.description: Build a bounded source-linked heading and outline graph from direct paragraph outline levels plus exact paragraph-style inheritance without opening Word. The default returns only main-story hierarchy metadata; heading text, style IDs and source locations are separately opt-in. Localized style names are never used as evidence, outline value 9 is body text, and unresolved styles or revision/MCE branches remain explicit coverage gaps.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_semantic_roles
tools.title: Find source-linked theorem and mathematical-role candidates
tools.description: Inspect bounded theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, definition, proof, example, remark, axiom or assumption paragraph candidates from explicit Word content-control declarations, exact style conventions and conservative Polish/English leading labels. Evidence authority and conflicts remain separate; the action never claims semantic completeness, returns text or identities without opt-in, opens Word, follows external relationships or mutates the package.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_ocr_candidates
tools.title: Inspect embedded Word image OCR candidates
tools.description: Build a bounded source-linked OCR candidate graph from images actually referenced by Word figures. It deduplicates repeated package parts, verifies declared media types against payload signatures, reports vector/oversized/unsafe candidates and never returns image bytes, follows external relationships, invokes an OCR provider, opens Word or mutates the package.

tools.name: run_ooxml_ocr
tools.title: Run provenance-bound OCR over selected Word images
tools.description: Run one registered OCR provider over at most eight exact fingerprint-bound embedded raster candidates. The default local-only policy rejects providers that declare network or credential access. The built-in Tesseract adapter requires an explicit absolute local-filesystem executable and model directory or preconfigured environment variables, rejects UNC/mapped-network and reparse-point paths, streams image bytes through stdin without temporary image files, applies one end-to-end timeout, validates TSV geometry/confidence/text, rechecks provider/model and source hashes and never returns raw image/provider output, paths or XML. Text, hashes, lines and words remain separately bounded opt-ins; matching hashes do not claim deterministic reproduction across an unbound host environment.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_notes
tools.title: Inspect Word footnote and endnote integrity
tools.description: Inspect a bounded source-linked graph of footnote/endnote definitions, ordinary references, document-wide special references and document/section numbering policies without opening Word. The compact default returns only guarded removal candidates and bounded issues; raw XML and note text are never returned.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_note_repair
tools.title: Plan guarded footnote or endnote repair
tools.description: Plan removal of one fingerprinted empty orphan or one canonically identical redundant duplicate note definition. The engine never invents note content or special-note types; it reparses the exact candidate, preserves every reference and numbering policy, forbids new note issues, checks unplanned entries and proves an exact inverse.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_note_repair
tools.title: Apply reviewed footnote or endnote repair
tools.description: Rebuild and atomically apply the exact reviewed note-definition removal to the fingerprinted package. The action rejects plan drift, source drift, signatures, missing Microsoft schema validation and new schema errors, and retains a sibling backup by default.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_equation_repairs
tools.title: Inspect guarded OfficeMath repair candidates
tools.description: Inspect bounded fingerprint-bound groups of canonically identical duplicate OMML property containers or properties. Formula text and raw OMML are never returned; ambiguous, non-equivalent and unsupported damage remains explicit and is never guessed.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_equation_repair
tools.title: Plan guarded OfficeMath duplicate repair
tools.description: Plan a batch of at most 32 fingerprinted removals of complete groups of later canonically identical OMML property containers or properties. The candidate is reprojected, normalized math semantics and every unplanned entry are preserved, no equation issue may be added, and an exact inverse is proved. Apply remains blocked unless Microsoft schema errors decrease.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_equation_repair
tools.title: Apply reviewed OfficeMath duplicate repair
tools.description: Rebuild and atomically apply the exact reviewed OfficeMath duplicate-removal batch. The action rejects source or plan drift, signatures, missing validation, new schema errors and any candidate that fails to reduce Microsoft Open XML schema errors; a sibling backup is retained by default.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_relationships
tools.title: Inspect Word OPC relationship usage
tools.description: Inspect a bounded typed graph of Word OPC relationships without opening Word. The compact default returns only proven unreferenced explicit relationships plus orphan relationship parts; include_all exposes classifications for referenced, implicit, unknown, binary-owner and invalid-owner relationships. External target values and raw XML are never returned.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_relationship_repair
tools.title: Plan guarded Word OPC relationship repair
tools.description: Plan one atomic batch that removes only fingerprinted unreferenced explicit relationships or whole orphan relationship parts. The candidate is reparsed and must preserve semantic projection, every unplanned entry, all unplanned relationships, structural-error monotonicity and package reachability; relationship deletion never cascades to target-part deletion. The plan returns no external targets or raw XML.

tools.name: apply_ooxml_relationship_repair
tools.title: Apply reviewed Word OPC relationship repair
tools.description: Rebuild and atomically apply the exact reviewed relationship repair batch to the fingerprinted source package. The action rejects plan drift, concurrent changes, signatures, missing Microsoft schema validation, new schema errors and unauthorized removal of external relationships. It keeps a sibling backup by default and returns no target values or raw XML.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_theme
tools.title: Inspect the Word document theme
tools.description: Inspect the typed Office theme graph behind Word theme colors, major/minor fonts, and format-style inventories without opening Word. Compact resolved metadata is returned by default; raw declarations, transforms, unknown markup, and source ordinals are opt-in to minimize AI tokens.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return color slots, primary and supplemental theme fonts, or the format-scheme inventory.

detail.description: Use declared to include bounded raw source values, transforms, supplemental metadata, and unknown markup.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded missing-slot, environment-dependent, and unresolved-transform diagnostics.

include_source.description: Include source XML element ordinals.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_settings
tools.title: Inspect Word document settings
tools.description: Inspect a typed settings.xml graph without opening Word: Boolean document behavior, theme font languages, compatibility mode, protection metadata, legacy document variables, mail merge, view settings, and a root inventory. Secret-bearing variable values, connection strings, queries, and relationship targets are redacted unless explicitly requested; pagination keeps AI token use bounded.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return compact Boolean settings, compatibility declarations, privacy-redacted document variables, mail-merge metadata, or the root-element inventory.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to bounded document-variable names and values, mail-merge queries and connection strings, and template/data-source targets. Protection hashes and salts are never returned.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded settings diagnostics.

include_source.description: Include settings part URI and source XML element ordinals.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_references
tools.title: Inspect Word fields, bookmarks, and dependencies
tools.description: Inspect a bounded, story-aware graph of paired bookmarks, nested complex fields, simple fields, parsed field types, and reference dependencies without opening Word. The parser never evaluates fields, launches applications, or follows external targets. Bookmark names, field instructions, result text, and dependency keys are redacted by default; compact views, exact filters, and pagination minimize AI token use.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return field-type counts, story boundaries, paired bookmarks, fields, dependency edges, or diagnostics.

field_type.description: Optional exact case-insensitive field-type filter for summary, fields, and dependencies views, for example REF, TOC, SEQ, HYPERLINK, or DDEAUTO.

bookmark_name.description: Optional exact case-insensitive bookmark-name filter for bookmarks and bookmark dependency edges.

story_id.description: Optional exact story identifier returned by the stories view.

detail.description: Use parsed for bounded instruction-token metadata. Token values and instruction text remain redacted unless include_sensitive is true.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to bounded bookmark names, dependency keys, instruction text, and parsed token values. External targets are never followed.

include_result_text.description: Include at most 4096 characters of cached field-result text per returned field. Requires include_sensitive=true.

include_issues.description: Include at most 40 bounded structural and unresolved-reference diagnostics in non-issues views.

include_source.description: Include story part URIs, semantic node IDs, and source XML element ordinals.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_bibliography
tools.title: Inspect Word bibliography sources and citation bindings
tools.description: Inspect bounded Word bibliography source collections stored in Custom XML and join CITATION field tags to concrete sources without opening Word, evaluating fields, running bibliography XSLT, or following external targets. Collections, source types, LCIDs, typed scalar-field metadata, contributor structure, duplicate identities and unresolved citations are source-linked. Duplicate singleton identity fields fail closed. Tags, titles, GUIDs, contributor names, field values, style paths and URIs are redacted by default with process-scoped keyed fingerprints; compact views, exact filters, pagination and a 65,536-character projected-payload budget minimize AI token use.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return source-type counts, source collections, sources, typed scalar fields, contributor structure, CITATION bindings, or diagnostics.

source_id.description: Optional exact bibliography source ID returned for the same package fingerprint.

source_tag.description: Optional exact case-insensitive Word bibliography Tag filter. The response returns only its fingerprint unless include_sensitive is true.

source_type.description: Optional exact case-insensitive bibliography SourceType filter, for example Book or JournalArticle.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to bounded source tags, titles, GUIDs, contributor names, scalar values, selected-style paths and collection URIs. External targets are never followed.

include_issues.description: Include at most 30 bounded bibliography diagnostics in non-issues views.

include_source.description: Include bibliography part URIs and source XML element ordinals.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_mail_merge
tools.title: Inspect Word mail merge configuration and bindings
tools.description: Inspect a bounded typed graph of saved Word mail-merge settings, ODSO configuration, source relationships, positional field mappings, recipient-selection data and MERGEFIELD/MERGEBARCODE bindings without opening Word, opening a data source, executing a query or merge, or following external targets. Supports Transitional and Strict WordprocessingML plus the legacy recipient-data namespace. Queries, connection strings, UDL strings, table and column names, field targets, recipient identities, relationship targets and source locations are redacted by default with process-scoped keyed fingerprints. Views are paged under a 65,536-character projected-payload budget.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return compact object-family counts, mail-merge configuration, source relationships, ODSO mappings, recipient-selection records, merge fields, or diagnostics.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to bounded queries, connection and UDL strings, table and column names, declared mapping names, field targets, mail subject/address metadata, and recipient identity values. This does not open or execute the source.

include_relationship_targets.description: Separately opt in to bounded declared internal and external relationship targets. External targets are never followed.

include_source.description: Separately opt in to bounded part URIs, semantic/story IDs, resolved target part URIs, and XML element ordinals.

include_issues.description: Include at most 30 bounded mail-merge diagnostics beside non-issues views.

tools.name: plan_ooxml_mail_merge_schema_binding
tools.title: Plan Word mail merge source-schema bindings
tools.description: Build a deterministic fingerprint-bound binding plan between saved MERGEFIELD/MERGEBARCODE objects, typed NEXT/NEXTIF/SKIPIF/MERGEREC/MERGESEQ controls and a caller-supplied ordered source-column schema. The action accepts column names and declared scalar kinds but no record values. It never opens Microsoft Word, a workbook, database, ODBC/OLE DB provider, query, external relationship target or merge destination, and never executes a merge. Missing, ambiguous, case-colliding or incomplete fields, malformed controls and dynamic conditional IF shapes fail closed. Names and comparison literals are process-HMAC fingerprinted unless include_sensitive is explicitly enabled; details are paged under a 65,536-character projected response budget.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

expected_package_fingerprint.description: Exact SHA-256 package fingerprint returned by a preceding inspection.

source_columns.description: Ordered source schema only. Record values are forbidden and have no input field.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to bounded target, required-column and matched source-column names. No record values exist in this operation.

include_source.description: Opt in to source-schema column ordinals in binding and issue pages.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_dependencies
tools.title: Inspect the Word document dependency graph
tools.description: Inspect one source-linked dependency graph spanning OPC reachability, semantic containment, styles, numbering, typed heading hierarchy and outline-level authority, fields/bookmarks, bibliography sources and resolved CITATION tags, core/extended/custom properties, persistent document variables and resolved DOCPROPERTY/DOCVARIABLE fields, section stories, classic charts, logical figures/resources/captions, content controls/Custom XML bindings, nested-table topology, and typed active-content declarations, payloads and ActiveX bindings without opening Word. Unresolved and external targets remain explicit; external targets are never followed. Fields and active content are never executed, binary payloads are never decoded, embedded packages are never opened, and signature presence is not cryptographic validation. One operation-wide accounted resource lease covers bounded ZIP/OPC admission and metadata, XML parsing, semantic and typed projections, while the graph keeps its independent local byte budget and compact adjacency. Keys and source are redacted by default, views are paged, and unmodeled domains stay explicit.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return compact edge-kind counts, graph nodes, graph edges, unresolved edges, a bounded neighborhood around node_id, or dependency diagnostics.

node_id.description: Optional exact dependency node ID from the same package fingerprint. Required for the impact view.

node_kind.description: Optional exact node-kind filter for the nodes view.

edge_kind.description: Optional exact edge-kind filter for edge, unresolved, and impact views.

direction.description: Direction used when node_id filters edges and during impact traversal.

max_depth.description: Maximum edge depth for the impact view. Traversal has an independent hard edge budget.

include_keys.description: Opt in to bounded internal node keys. Keys can contain bookmark names, field targets, part URIs, or external relationship targets; external content is never fetched.

include_source.description: Include bounded part URIs, relationship metadata, semantic node IDs, and XML element ordinals.

include_issues.description: Opt in to at most 40 bounded cross-domain dependency diagnostics in non-issues views.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_charts
tools.title: Inspect native Word charts
tools.description: Inspect a bounded, source-linked graph of classic DrawingML charts in a saved Word package without opening Word, embedded workbooks, or external targets. Understands the 16 standard classic plot families, series, axes, formulas, cache metadata, chart references, embedded packages and related parts in Transitional and Strict OOXML. Cached point values are never returned. Titles and formulas are redacted unless include_sensitive is true; source relationship targets remain redacted unless include_source is true. Office 2016 extended chart parts are preserved and reported honestly as unmodeled.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return compact plot-type counts, chart metadata, series and data-source metadata, axes, package relationships, or diagnostics.

detail.description: Use declared for additional bounded chart settings, sensitive-opt-in format codes, auto-update flags, and unmodeled-element counts.

chart_id.description: Optional exact chart ID from the same package fingerprint.

chart_type.description: Optional exact classic DrawingML plot-type filter.

include_sensitive.description: Opt in to bounded chart-title text and series formulas. Cached point values are never returned.

include_source.description: Opt in to bounded part URIs, content types, relationship IDs and targets, namespaces, and source XML element ordinals. External targets are never followed.

include_issues.description: Include at most 20 bounded chart diagnostics in non-issues views.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_diagrams
tools.title: Inspect native Word SmartArt diagrams
tools.description: Inspect a bounded graph of native SmartArt diagram data, points, connections, layout/color/style parts, and persisted drawing parts in a saved Word package without opening Word or executing layout. Supports Transitional and Strict DiagramML relationship and element namespaces. Point text and raw XML are never returned. Model keys, keyed fingerprints, and source provenance require independent opt-ins; one shared operation budget and a 10 KiB projected-item ceiling keep AI context bounded.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return compact part-kind counts, diagrams, points, connections, related parts, or diagnostics.

diagram_id.description: Optional exact SmartArt diagram ID from the same package fingerprint.

include_keys.description: Opt in to bounded DiagramML model IDs, definition IDs, presentation association IDs, names, and labels. Point text remains unavailable.

include_hashes.description: Separately opt in to process-keyed 16-hex fingerprints of DiagramML identifiers and source-part SHA-256 values.

include_source.description: Separately opt in to bounded part URIs, content and relationship types, relationship IDs and targets, and XML element ordinals. External targets are never followed.

include_issues.description: Include at most 10 bounded SmartArt diagnostics beside the selected view.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_figures
tools.title: Inspect Word figures and captions
tools.description: Inspect a bounded, source-linked graph of logical figures, DrawingML/VML representations, declared anchor placement and wrapping, nested DrawingML/VML shape topology, transforms, preset/custom path geometry, fills, lines, effects, text-flow declarations, accessibility metadata, resource relationships, caption paragraphs, SEQ fields, and evidence-scored figure-caption associations in a saved Word package. AlternateContent Choice/Fallback representations are grouped into one logical figure; without an application capability context no branch is reported as active or primary. Transitional and Strict OOXML are supported. Text, alternative text, source paths, exact VML length lexemes, relationship targets, shape details, path commands, formula coordinates, and wrap-polygon coordinates are redacted by default. Declared placement and shape geometry are not reported as rendered page geometry. The engine never opens Word, decodes binary resources, follows external targets, or executes active content; ambiguous proximity is reported instead of asserted as fact.

local_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the local DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file.

view.description: Return compact object-family counts, logical figures, physical representations, caption evidence, association decisions, resource metadata, or diagnostics.

detail.description: Use declared for additional placement, DrawingML, unmodeled-payload, content-type, relationship-type, and hash metadata.

figure_id.description: Optional exact logical figure ID from the same package fingerprint.

caption_id.description: Optional exact caption ID from the same package fingerprint.

include_text.description: Opt in to bounded figure names, title/description alternative text, caption labels/text, field results, and style names.

include_source.description: Opt in to bounded part URIs, semantic node IDs, source paths/ordinals, relationship IDs/types, DrawingML URIs, content types, and resource hashes.

include_relationship_targets.description: Separately opt in to bounded internal part paths and declared external relationship targets. External targets are never followed.

include_issues.description: Include at most 20 bounded figure/caption diagnostics in non-issues views.

include_geometry.description: With view=representations, detail=declared and max_items no greater than 2, opt in to at most 128 declared wrap-polygon coordinates plus, when include_shape_details is also true, at most 64 shape paths, 128 path commands, 256 formula points and 4096 formula characters per representation. This does not execute Word layout or return rendered page coordinates.

include_shape_details.description: With view=representations, detail=declared and max_items no greater than 2, opt in to a flattened bounded shape topology with transforms, geometry/effect/text-flow summaries and at most 64 shape nodes per representation. Shape text still requires include_text; path commands and formula coordinates still require include_geometry.

tools.name: inspect_ooxml_content_controls
tools.title: Inspect Word content controls and XML bindings
tools.description: Inspect bounded, source-linked Word content controls, physical Custom XML stores, built-in core/extended property stores, data-binding targets, and repeating-section topology without opening Word or returning Custom XML values. The engine recognizes Transitional and Strict WordprocessingML, Office 2010 checkbox/entity controls, Office 2013 repeating sections and rich-text bindings. XPath execution is restricted to a safe absolute child-element subset; unsupported expressions remain explicit diagnostics.
